text: The medallion layers are planned. Before any of it can exist, we have to plan how the Azure infrastructure underneath it actually gets built, in code.
Bicep owns the foundation -- storage, networking, Key Vault. Terraform owns the workspace layer -- Databricks, Unity Catalog, and Fabric. Every change goes through CI before it merges.
Bicep handles the Azure-native resources that rarely change. Terraform handles the Databricks and Fabric workspace resources, because its providers are the mature way to manage those APIs.
Infra branches, mandatory pull requests, two reviewers, and a required plan output -- and apply only ever runs from the pipeline, never a laptop.
The infrastructure plan is locked. Next: designing the real-time Kafka path scan events actually travel through.
